<!-- pr-reviewer: 09f5d385a3fce6610f676cd923c5018e16f625f6 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Thanks for the careful fix and the red-first pins.

**What looks good**
- Fix is tiny and local: only `Camera::toward` (pole case) and `basis_right`'s zero-guard change; edges, corners, `oriented` and orbit take the unchanged `atan2` path (orbit clamps pitch to +-1.5, so only `toward` can reach an exact pole).
- Exact `n[2].abs() == 1.0` is fine: face-click directions are axis-aligned and normalize to exactly +-1.0. A direction that is merely near-pole falls to the `atan2` path where `basis_right` is well-conditioned, so no tolerance is needed (and none could produce a wrong view).
- BOT handedness checked: `cos(-pi/2)` stays positive, so the near-pole limit of `normalize(fy,-fx)` is `(-sin y, cos y)` at both poles; the guard returns the same expression, so right/up are not mirrored.
- Second pole click is idempotent (quarter-snapped yaw snaps to itself); snap bound <= 45 deg is pinned.
- Tests are structural/unit (no snapshot PNGs touched); decision file present; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #622`; no CHANGELOG edit; no deps/build.rs/.github/scripts changes. No unwrap/panic added.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main; already up to date, no conflicts)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from crates/ui) | 377 passed, 2 failed (below), 5 ignored |
| `view_cube` tests (8, incl. the 4 pins + gesture test) | 8 passed |
| `projection` / `viewport` filters | 8 / 11 passed |
| `shell_structure_light` in isolation | passed (flaky parallel theme state, as the PR notes) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Failure unrelated to this PR (no GPU adapter on the review machine, #615/#623):
```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds: No suitable graphics adapter found; ... metal had no fallback adapters
```

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `basis_right`'s pole fallback now depends on `self.yaw` for any exact-pole camera, not just ones built by `toward`; harmless today since nothing else reaches a pole.
- `law_tests.rs` is ~1980 lines (already far over the 400 guide; growth is small here).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
